parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true: `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveMaster` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package: Metadata) and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package: app:iOS). Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.714, the two methods resolve structurally different entity types (`Master` vs `Artist`) and live in separate test targets serving distinct test suites. Collapsing them into a generic function would couple unrelated test fixtures across package boundaries without meaningful production benefit. Per the decision rules, all-test clusters are treated as intentional duplication.
